sources.title: Our Interview with Andrew Feldman, CEO of Cerebras Systems
sources.quote_checked: Every square millimeter of your chip needs to be tuned for this work. | Not if it was repurposed. | One of the things we observed right away was that the GPU has a problem with memory. | Its memory is far away. | when you communicate on a chip, you're 1000 times faster | the hard part of this work was moving data, moving data from memory to the core moving data from core to core. | Before this, I founded a company with Gary, around some of Gary's ideas, called SeaMicro. | We built that over a four year period and we sold that to AMD in 2012.

sources.title: Andrew Feldman, Co-Founder & CEO of Cerebras Systems – Interview Series
sources.quote_checked: We realized that deep learning has unique, massive, and growing computational requirements. | AI today is constrained not by applications or ideas, but by the availability of compute. | build a new type of computer optimized exclusively for deep learning | We designed and manufactured the largest chip ever built. | Our ability to move data off-chip lags our ability to increase the performance on a chip by a great deal.
